column2: Everything you need for the day in one place
On “Today”, “First steps” await you — six simple tasks to get comfortable. And in each section {0} will point out the main thing once.
The intro and questionnaire can be repeated in settings
Just sign in with Google — and everything sets itself up.
Add a goal or list in “Plans”
Hooray! You've got the hang of it
First steps hidden — you can bring them back in settings
Here are goals, your lists, habits and “Time again” — recurring tasks. Say “Add milk to shopping” — the list appears by itself.
Your dreams, goals and lists live here. Say “I want a scooter” — and the dream appears.
You don't have to type expenses: photograph the receipt or say “coffee 120”. {n} picks the category itself.
Say “bought ice cream for 50” — I'll log it. That way you see how much is left for your dream.
Water, food, steps and diary. Photograph your plate — {n} will count calories and protein.
Log water and what you ate. Tap a ring — you'll see how much is left.
Type or hold the orb and speak. {n} remembers what matters about you and can add a task, expense or reminder itself.
You can type or hold the button and speak. I'll understand everything.
Swipe through days with your finger. Say “When am I free on Friday?” — {n} will find slots, including travel time.
Here are all your tasks by day. Swipe left and right.
Tap “−” on a block you don't need. It will appear here and can be brought back.
“{0}” will return when something appears in it
Order saved. Reset to default — in Settings
Blocks can be rearranged, removed and restored: hold a block

In “Today”, “Plans”, “Money” and “Health”, hold a block and drag — it will move. Hold and release without moving (or tap “Edit blocks” at the bottom of the section) — blocks get a “−” so you can remove extras. Removed blocks wait at the bottom of the section; “+” puts them back.
Drink a liter of water before {0}:00
no tasks for parents in a while
the streak broke yesterday — you can start again today
Sum up the day in the evening
the most important thing — while your head is fresh
All three — another +{0} over the cap
steps needed — each one becomes a hit
The worst part is behind you. You can take a reward from “My path”.
Break the boss into small steps — each step will be a hit.
“{0}” and its steps will disappear. Points for past hits too.
A big unpleasant task that's been hanging for a long time. Break it into steps — and hit them one by one.
Completed {0} of {1} · each step reveals the next piece of the map
With every rank the waves in the orb on the button glow brighter and lighter. Progress is visible without numbers.
A big unpleasant task — taxes, clearing the balcony — becomes a boss. Each step is a hit (+{0}), victory is +{1}.
Break a goal or dream into steps — and it becomes a road with milestones.
Tasks one after another, with breaks of no more than 15 minutes: the third in a row — points ×1.5, from the fifth — ×2. The counter shows next to checkmarks and at the bottom of the screen.
three a day for weak spots; all three — another +{0}
tasks in a row: third ×1.5, from the fifth ×2
defeating a boss — +{0} over the cap
makes mistakes on the fly · tap to make it accurate for free
Groq key connected · tap to turn on accurate mode
the whole phrase, with commas and names · free
speech is recognized by Whisper — one of the most accurate models
speech is recognized by the iPhone: on the fly, so it first writes nonsense and doesn't always manage to fix it
Accurate: while you speak — a wave; words appear after a pause, correct right away. If the server doesn't respond, it switches to the iPhone automatically.
Names and words that get mixed up
Whisper listens to the whole phrase and writes almost without mistakes. Free: you need a Groq key, up to 8 hours of speech per day.
Open the Groq website and sign in with Google.
Tap “Create API Key”, name it “IZIDAY” and copy the key.
The key is stored only on this phone. The audio of a phrase goes to Groq only to turn it into text.
Key removed — the iPhone recognizes speech
